create.title: Balanced quarter-packet normalization, owner correction, and blockwise scope
create.statement_tex: Fix one real smooth positive-frequency residual physical block B=(X,D,L,+) with R=sqrt X, K=XL/D^2 and 1<=K/L<=16. Let Omega_B index only bounded internal smooth subdivisions of this one block, and let a fixed smooth gcd partition have full small shells G below L^(1/2) plus one explicit crossing-shell owner. Conditional on the coefficientwise real C_c^infinity bridge psi_G(g)A_(B,omega)(gu,gv;X)=F_(B,omega,u,v,G)(g/G), h=gu, k=gv and gcd(u,v)=1, Poisson with Fhat(xi)=int F(t)e(-t xi)dt gives T_(B,small)^(+,full)=(1/(2i))sum_(omega,G)GQ_(B,omega,G)^(full)+E_(gcd-bd), where Q is exactly the chi_4(u)-weighted 1/4 packet minus the 3/4 packet. For real profiles Q(-R)=-conj(Q(R)), and the minus sign cancels conjugation of 1/(2i), yielding physical frequency conjugacy. The smooth packet represents the full small-gcd shell: if exact-square and R^(-1)-near-square terms are prior owners, the residual equals the full packet plus the explicit gcd-boundary term minus their exact signed subtotals; their arithmetic complement cannot be silently inserted into the smooth g/G profile. The required open norm is the modulus outside the complete internal (omega,G)-sum for each fixed physical block separately. Shellwise l1, product-fibre absolute values and Cauchy or Gram norms are stronger. Distinct D or L blocks cannot cancel before the accepted blockwise assembly. The current envelope loses min(L^(1/2),R^(1/2)/L), maximally X^(1/12) at L=X^(1/6). The existing artifacts do not instantiate the finite literal atom dictionary of profiles, clipped or starred weights, crossings and transform-error labels, so no standalone literal residual theorem or analytic estimate is included.
create.next_action: Instantiate the coefficientwise finite atom dictionary for one smooth balanced physical block from the accepted dyadic profile, Vaaler coefficient and stationary transform. Verify its one-count identity, crossing owners and uniform seminorms before attempting the open signed packet estimate.

update.next_action: Retain this as the abstract uniformly smooth full-small-gcd reduction. Use the exact 1/4-minus-3/4 normalization and explicit owner corrections from M9-M2-balanced-quarter-packet-normalization-scope. Do not call it a literal owner-removed residual theorem until the atom dictionary is instantiated.

First instantiate the literal atom dictionary for each fixed smooth physical (D,L,+) block. Then prove the modulus-outside internal (omega,G)-sum bound at L^(3/2)X^epsilon. Do not use cancellation across distinct physical blocks, hide square or near-square masks in the smooth gcd profile, or substitute shellwise l1, unsigned spacing or an arbitrary-coefficient Gram.

Retain the blockwise owner architecture. The balanced hypothesis is applied separately to each literal smooth (D,L) block after its internal subdivisions recombine; the assembly does not license cancellation across blocks. Hard and unbalanced parents remain independent.

reject.reason: Under the stated Fourier convention the exact character identity gives the 1/4 packet minus the 3/4 packet. Reversing them changes the sign.
For real profiles Q(-R)=-conj(Q(R)); only after multiplying by 1/(2i) does the physical negative child become the conjugate.
Smooth Poisson transforms the full small-gcd shell. An exact square or near-square complement is arithmetic and nonsmooth in g; prior owners require explicit signed correction terms.
The accepted M2 assembly bounds each physical D,L block before summation. Only bounded internal subdivisions of one fixed block may lie under the packet's outer modulus.
A smooth shell meeting g=L^(1/2) must be assigned explicitly to the large or boundary gcd owner; a sharp cutoff creates an unowned Fourier tail.
The direct signed internal sum can cancel between shells. Shellwise l1 and Gram estimates are strictly stronger sufficient conditions.
The negative-frequency identity uses the literal real profile and beta_(-h)=beta_h. It fails for a generic complex coefficient.
The unique physical profile containing d=floor(sqrt X) has a continuum jump and is excluded from smooth Poisson regardless of its scale exponent.
Symmetry cancels only odd m congruent to 3 modulo 4, reinforces odd m congruent to 1 modulo 4, and supplies no character-bearing swapped term for even products.
The identity is capacity-preserving. X^(1/12) is the worst remaining deficit of the current envelope, not a saving.

no_change.reason: The literal dictionary and the signed L^(3/2) estimate remain unproved.
Round 112 treats only smooth balanced blocks.
The unbalanced product-phase parent is independent.
The hard, balanced and unbalanced M2 parents remain open.
Uniform completion of all physical packets remains open.
Neither M9-M1 nor M9-M2 is closed.

round_assessment.reason: Round 112 certifies all relative quarter-packet constants, conjugacy, owner corrections and norm scope, and prevents two material one-count errors. It identifies the first literal atom-dictionary seam and a precise next deliverable, but proves no analytic estimate, range or exponent.
